Deepa Jewellers Shares Debut With Significant Premium on Stock Exchanges

Deepa Jewellers made a strong debut on the stock market, with shares listing at a significant premium. On the National Stock Exchange (NSE), the shares opened at ₹221 per share. On the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), they opened at ₹221.05 per share. This listing represents a substantial gain over the initial public offering (IPO) price, with one report indicating a 25% premium.
